sources.title: Visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry service page directs entry-visa enquiries to the eVisa portal, but contains no ordinary-passport nationality result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For information on visas for entry into Trinidad and Tobago, please visit the e-Visa Portal.

sources.title: Visa Application Instructions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry PDF gives a current September 2025 fee and eVisa delivery instructions, but tells prospective visitors to consult a country list rather than reproduce a current full nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: To find out if you need a visa, consult the list of countries.

sources.title: List of countries whose citizens do not require entry visas for Trinidad and Tobago
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Immigration Division PDF is a positive waiver list and does not state that omitted ordinary-passport nationalities require a visa or identify their issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the countries listed below do not require visas for entry.

sources.title: Visa Online Services
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry page confirms an eVisa service but publishes documents and fees, not a nationality eligibility or issuance result for this residual.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Possession of an eVisa does not guarantee your entry into Trinidad and Tobago.

sources.title: Visa & Student Permit
sources.officialityEvidence: The live government portal makes eVisa availability conditional on being a visa-required foreign national; it has no nationality crosswalk and cannot establish the baseline for any omitted passport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: eligible foreign nationals from visa-required countries can apply for a Multiple Entry eVisa

sources.title: eVISA Frequently Asked Questions
sources.publisher: Immigration Division, Ministry of Homeland Security
sources.officialityEvidence: The linked Immigration Division eVisa FAQ gives online process and electronic delivery, while conditioning it on an applicant already being from a visa-required country and leaving the nationality eligibility questions unpublished.
sources.supportingExcerpt: be a foreign national from a country requiring a Visa.
